Why is LocalStorage capped at 5.0 MB? Standard web browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox) hard-cap synchronous localStorage at 5 MB per domain to keep tab execution smooth. Your personal SQL drafts, notes, and progress only take ~25 KB (<1%). If you clear the offline question schemas from LocalStorage, you will instantly reclaim ~2.5 MB of free space!
Storage Diagnostics & Controls Re-evaluate storage, pre-load questions, or purge offline cache to reclaim 2.5 MB.

Backup & Data Portability

Everything you create is stored on your device. Export complete backups or restore to continue practicing on another device.

100% Client-Side Privacy Guarantee

All your SQL code drafts, personal notes, and solved questions live strictly in your browser's local storage. Nothing is ever tracked, uploaded, or sent to external servers.

Upload & Restore SQLMaster Backup (.json)
Drag and drop your backup file here, or click anywhere to choose from computer
Instant Restore Restores all SQL query drafts, notes, stars, and solved progress directly into this browser.
Download Full Backup (JSON) Recommended
Saves EVERYTHING: all your written SQL query drafts for each question, personal notes, solved status, attempted list, bookmarks, submissions counter, and settings.
Download Compact Progress Only Lightweight
Exports solved status, attempted list, bookmarks, notes, and settings without query drafts (compatible with legacy sqlmaster_backup_YYYY-MM-DD.json).
Export Markdown Study Handbook Handbook
Generates a formatted Markdown study guide (.md) containing all your solved problems, your SQL solutions, and your personal approach notes for offline review.
Restore / Import from Backup Load any previous backup file (Full or Compact). You will preview the contents before confirming. Supports merge or replace.
Storage Maintenance & Clear Clear drafts to free storage, reset practice checklist, or factory reset all data.
